verdict.rationale: Both PRs make the same production change: they reuse `gross_total` and `format_eur` and add the `Gesamtbetrag` line right after the item list. B also adds a test that pins the exact line position and German formatting through a shipping-inclusive amount. That amount checks out: 30.00 net + 2.10 reduced VAT + 1202.40 shipping = 1.234,50 EUR. B's report says it ran the tests (9 passed, consistent with 8 existing + 1 new) and mentions that shipping is included without its own line. A ships the change with no tests and says it is unverified.
a_issues: No test added for the new Gesamtbetrag line, so its position and formatting are unprotected
Change was not run or verified (honestly reported)
b_issues: Test covers only one order shape (one item plus shipping); there is no case without shipping or with multiple VAT classes

verdict.rationale: Both changes make the same production edit: one line that reuses `gross_total` and `format_eur`, placed right after the item list. A also adds a correct test. It covers the placement, the German formatting with a thousands separator, and shipping being included (30.00 + 2.10 + 1202.40 = 1234.50). A's report accurately says the tests were run (9 passed). B honestly says it is untested but adds no tests, so the new line has no protection against regressions.
b_issues: No test added for the new Gesamtbetrag line, its placement, or its formatting
Tests were not run, so the change is unverified
